reviews.author: Eric Howard
reviews.text: Tommy was very quick and he was careful with the car. I was concerned that maybe there would be some scuffing of plastic because the front of the car is low to the ground, but there was none and he was careful with attaching the vehicle to the flatbed.

reviews.author: Wes Rhodes
reviews.text: Had a great experience this evening with Joel towing my car. He was a professional and ensured I stayed warm in this bitter cold evening. Car was secured and strapped well! I’d recommend their service to anyone needing a quick tow!

reviews.author: Yessy Bustos
reviews.text: The driver was very polite, respectful and professional. I appreciated the thorough process of documenting photographs before and after having the vehicle towed. Their customer service was excellent and felt they went above and beyond to ensure their customers did not experience any added stress. Highly recommend for emergency situations!

reviews.author: Andrew Mace
reviews.text: Jeremy was quick fast and efficient! Knew what he was doing and when he gave me an estimated time he would arrive he was there. Worked quickly to get my vehicle loaded and me off the highway. Would definitely use his service again. I would actually give him 10 stars!

reviews.author: Daniel Mahood
reviews.text: So my Tesla died and the vehicle was totally locked up and there was nothing you could do, however, Mike came and took care of it and saved the day. He got it safely in his flatbed and to Tesla for service.. He’s very friendly and knowledgeable and I would recommend him anytime to help you out.

reviews.author: lisa tomcho
reviews.text: This company is awesome. So dedicated to customer service. We had a flat tire in the middle of nowhere and this towing company literally saved us. He went above and beyond to help our family. I wish I could give more stars. I would recommend anytime. Best service in a long time. I wish more companies were like this. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kelly Smith
reviews.text: Thomas was very helpful and kind. I really appreciated his quickness and willingness to figure out what was going on with our car. I would definitely recommend Wolfpack Towing any time you need towing/recovery services. Thomas was excellent and saved the night.

reviews.author: Boris Golds
reviews.text: Out of all the towing companies in this area, these guys are the best. I needed several cars towed for our dealership. They gave us a time for pick up and quoted us a price. At the end of it all they were on time and I ended up paying the exact price they quoted. Fair and honest company, definitely use them.

reviews.author: David Rippy
reviews.text: Trellis is great. Polite and professional. Taking the time to explain and joke about a few things in a stressful situation aided in the entire process. Solid service with frequent updates via text or call. Drivers will answer when you call. Well done!

reviews.author: shawntel tulpan
reviews.text: Jeremey was super fast when he arrived. Very friendly and professional. He even gave me pointers to avoid flat tires in the future. THANK YOU AGAIN SO MUCH!

reviews.author: Kim Bowers
reviews.text: After a long, frustrating wait for a driver who never showed, Jeremy arrived with a smile on his face and encouraging words to turn my bad situation into a much more pleasant one. He went above and beyond and I’m very appreciative.

reviews.author: Glavin Jun
reviews.text: I had a flat tire, found Wolfpack to have great reviews and was the cheapest. Called around 2PM and the operator told me they would be there between 40minutes to an hour. There was a Discount Tire about 10-15 minutes away and they closed at 6PM, so I planned to get back on the road that day. So I end up getting my car at the Discount Tire at around 6:15PM. I’m a college student and had no classes that day and my girlfriend was in town, but imagine if I waited 4 hours, just to have to uber home and come back the next day. Oh yeah, and risk getting towed for parking overnight. If that was all, whatever just never use their services again. But as soon as I turn on my car, “Check Blind Spot Monitors”, “Check Cross-Wheel System”, “Check Front Collision Sensors”, ABS light, Traction light, like my dash was a Christmas tree. When I called the towing company, the same operator I talked to the day prior pretty much told me, “okay we can’t do anything about it”. Fast forward today, went to my dealership to figure out what was wrong…Damaged Driver Side’s Front and Rear Wheel Speed Sensors. Ran me $180 for diagnosis and I soon have to pay for parts and labour. I mean I’ve been towed like 30 times (literally same car) and have never had problems like this after! If you want to gamble to see if they’ll get remotely close to the time they tell you, wonder if they even know what they’re doing, and have “I hate that I’m working right now” customer service, Wolfpack is for you.

reviews.author: Rick Wylie
reviews.text: Mike really came through for me this morning in a big way. He was professional and courteous. I had an awesome experience and am grateful.

reviews.author: Kenneth Stokes
reviews.text: Broke down at the sheetz in Smithfield, the eta was supposed to be 35 minutes. Mr Mike was there in around 15. He was very polite, and friendly. I will call Wolfpack towing again in the future for my towing needs.

reviews.author: Jessica Jones
reviews.text: Although I had a long wait time which I feel is normal for any tow company in the area this time of year, I received great service at a great price!

reviews.author: David Holub
reviews.text: Jeremy and Wolfpack came and towed my car today. Jeremy was thorough and treated my car like it was his own. This wasn't an easy tow. Locked in Park and on a hill. Needless to say Wolfpack showed up when they said they would, communicated throughout the entire process and delivered as promised.

reviews.author: Lashawn Wanamaker
reviews.text: Great fast the driver was nice which made the tow so much better and he communicated during the whole process. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Alexander Wellin
reviews.text: My dad tried to get a tow from this company through Allstate roadside assistance. After waiting about three hours he called them, and they said Allstate cancelled the tow. Allstate denies this and says Wolfpack cancelled. I don't know for sure who's lying, which is why I'm not giving a one-star review. If it was Wolfpack that lied, they could have just not accepted the request in the first place. We waited hours for nothing.

reviews.author: wei pan
reviews.text: The service was quick and efficient. Peter was friendly and knowledgeable. The process was very smooth. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amanda Collett
reviews.text: They were so nice! We were able to schedule for the car to be towed from our house. They had wonderful customer service!

reviews.author: Mercedes Hernandez
reviews.text: The driver was very professional. As for the service in its totality they were very courteous and got the job done. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brenna Brown
reviews.text: Peter, I believe his name was turned my horrible experience into a great one. He was super friendly, communicative and understanding.

reviews.author: Matt Pahl
reviews.text: They were able to tow me within an hour and gave me a ride to the dealership. Very helpful and friendly

reviews.author: Kendrick Thorpe
reviews.text: My driver was very attentive and got to me quickly and got my vehicle home with no issues! Highly recommended!!!!!!

reviews.author: Steve Caminiti
reviews.text: Great experience! Quick, efficient and super friendly service. Took the stress out of a stressful situation.

reviews.author: Jessica Mosley
reviews.text: Trellis was very professional when he came to tow my car to the dealership. He made sure my car wasn't scratch while loading on the flat bed.

reviews.author: TaLaura Davis
reviews.text: Jeremy has such a fun personality, he had my car on the tow truck and to it’s destination in minutes.

reviews.author: Javi Torres
reviews.text: I called around and the prices were high I got to Wolfpack towing and there price blew them out of the water. Great price and great people.

reviews.author: Dexter Stewart
reviews.text: The gentleman that responded was very nice and professional, and I appreciate him taking my truck to BJ'S.
